additional_readonly_whitespace_gate.reason: The ordinary index remains at cabc; this object-to-object check also covers the candidate's new source files without changing that index.

phase_contract: Pin source, ordinary HEAD/index, real locks, untracked set and original recipe bytes before execution.
Bind frozen full metadata/catalog/XML/review/terminal identities; they are evidence of the actual completed test source, not an assertion that scoped Clippy uses the full test feature graph.
Run original just fix for the exact 16 owner packages, passing --locked --profile dev-small to the unmodified clippy --fix --tests --allow-dirty recipe.
Capture stdout/stderr, exit code, before/after source tree, complete binary patch and every changed postimage before deciding whether to continue.
Stop on any automatic source change with explicit review-required terminal/outer3; original command exit remains recorded. No next hygiene command is run before root reviews the change.
Stop on command failure or index/lock/source guard drift with original evidence retained; never restore the index or silently accept a new checkpoint.
If previous commands made no source changes, proceed to original just fmt and original git diff --check, then the whole-candidate read-only whitespace check.
Export the whole candidate source map and complete changed postimages relative to the published cabc tree. Root owns review and publication.
No local A tests, optional validation suite, cache cleanup, policy change or ref mutation occurs after this hygiene sequence.
limits: Prepared only; root must triage the two new failures and bind an explicit execution guard before use.
The 14 same-name host-related failures, 25 early-return cases and original full just100/controller1 remain in their original evidence; hygiene cannot change their status.
Any automatic source change stops before the next hygiene stage for root review, even if the original command succeeded.
Any original command failure, index byte change, unexpected source path, lock drift or resource guard stops without reset, cleanup, retry or skipped commands.
